name: bonk-air3-meteor-cleave
notes: Concept for air.3 Downward Sweep, on its existing move-data clock (50 ticks, hitbox 21-36, no IASA).
character: Bonk (55 joints, five fingers; a 1.84 m greatsword fixed to the right hand as joint Weapon0 with bladeHilt and bladeEnd anchors)
image_notes: 1: the fall entry pose with the greatsword resting on the right shoulder (profile, front, three-quarter rear angle). 2: Bonk's own two-handed grip, from his Charging Double Slash (front, three-quarter, profile).
description:
Downward Sweep (air.3), Bonk's committed spike, as a meteor cleave: a two-handed overhead chop that keeps going down beneath him while his body jackknifes.

Bonk is the roster's heaviest fighter and its high-jumping acrobat: a hunched brute with huge arms, short legs and a head set low between the shoulders, swinging a 1.84 m greatsword. His aerials should look heavy and acrobatic at once.

Make the sword look heavy. In the air there is no ground to push from, so the whole body swings the blade: hips and chest wind up first and unwind first; the arms follow and the blade comes last, trailing behind the hands until it whips through. The wind-up is slow and readable, the strike takes a few fast ticks, and after contact the blade's momentum carries on and drags the body after it before Bonk reins it in (overshoot, then settle): never stop the blade dead. The legs balance the swing: they tuck to wind up and swing the opposite way to the blade during the strike.

Beats. Tick 0 is the fall pose: the sword rests on his right shoulder with the blade diagonally across his back. Ticks 1-6: the left hand comes up in front of the chest and takes the grip below the right hand. Ticks 1-15: load: arch the back and lean back, lift both hands above and slightly behind the head so the blade hangs down behind his back, tip pointing down behind him; knees pulled up in front, so the body bends backward like a drawn bow. Ticks 15-17: a moving hold while the blade sinks a little deeper behind. Ticks 17-21: the cleave: the chest jackknifes forward, the arms bring the blade over the head and down in front, and the legs kick backward as the chest folds. Contact at tick 21: both arms nearly straight, the blade pointing forward and about 45 degrees down. Ticks 22-30: the blade keeps sweeping down until it points almost straight down in front of and below his feet; the torso is folded forward about 45 degrees and the legs trail behind; the blade slows as it bottoms out. Ticks 31-36: hang in that low pose, still drifting down a little. Ticks 37-48: recover: he unfolds, the left hand lets go and the right arm carries the sword back up onto the shoulder. Ticks 48-50 equal the entry pose. The blade must not cut through his body or legs.

targets.name: blade tip below the hips at contact (m)
blade tip below the hips at the bottom of the sweep (m)
